title: Thin-layer chromatography
caption: On a silica plate the more polar compound sticks to the silica and moves less. Here the starting material (Rf 0.55) and the product (Rf 0.30) are clearly separated; the co-spot lane, with both applied together, shows two spots, confirming they are different.
alt: A TLC plate with three lanes: starting material (one spot high), co-spot (two spots), reaction mixture (one spot low).
description: Lane 3, reaction mixture: only 0.30: the starting material has been used up.
